snippet.title: Radio Commander: Pacific '41 | Gameplay Trailer
snippet.description:
Fight against the Japanese army during the tragic events of the Pacific War.
Analyze reports.
Make decisions.
Issue orders through radio messages.
Tip the scales of victory in your favor.
We’re counting on you, commander.

🎮 Wishlist now on Steam ➡️ https://store.steampowered.com/app/1621910/Radio_Commander_Pacific_Campaign/
💬 Join the Discord Server ➡️ https://discord.gg/SM9vzw3Z
